messages:
incbot: INCIDENT ALERT: p95 latency spike observed for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (hosted). Metric: p95 jumped from ~220ms -> ~2.1s around 2026-03-16T22:41Z. PagerDuty paging @eng-oncall (alice).

alice: Ack. Looking into it now. Any known customer impact?

bob: Pinged sales and account teams (cc @dana). Some customers reporting slow responses, no HTTP 5xx.

alice: Quick checks: node CPU low but memory high, swap activity present. vmstat snapshot from affected host:

```
procs -----------memory---------- ---swap-- -----io---- -system-- ------cpu-----
 r  b   swpd   free   buff  cache   si   so    bi    bo   in   cs us sy id wa st
 2  0  125000  204800  10240  512000   150  320   1200   2400  1800 2200 70 10 5 15 0
```

charlie: perf top on one suspect instance shows kernel reclaim/major faults dominating:

```
# perf top
 15.1%   [kernel] mm_vmscan_direct_reclaim_pages
 12.4%   [kernel] __handle_mm_fault
```

alice: Traces linked: p95 traces have long spans in "kv-cache read" and "model forward" where we see pagein waits. Shortlink: https://trace.redwood/s/abc123

dana: Customer impact tally: three Dedicated customers saw increased timeouts (5-10% of requests), multiple hosted customers experienced 2-5x latency on tail. Notifying account teams.

incbot: Suggested mitigations from playbook: 1) scale dedicated pool +20% 2) route traffic away from swap-heavy instances 3) route fraction to warm-cache model variant 4) consider kernel tweaks: increase vm.min_free_kbytes and lower swappiness temporarily.

alice: Applying routing change to steer 25% traffic to model-4q-warm now (lower quality warm cache fallback) - rolling update command: 

```
curl -XPOST https://api.redwood/route/update -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback":"model-4q-warm","weight":0.25}'
```

alice: Routing change applied. Observing p95 drop from ~2.1s -> ~800ms in the next ~8min. p50 remains ~180ms.

ryan-sre: Spinning up replacement prewarmed nodes and draining swap-heavy instances. Starting rsync of KV cache to new nodes to reduce cold page faults.

charlie: Collected perf/ktrace bundle: /var/tmp/trace-bundles/5132467890.tgz. Uploading to incident drive: https://drive.redwood/i/trace-bundles/5132467890.tgz

bob: Live timeline (short): 22:41 alert -> 22:45 routing change -> 22:53 p95 improved -> 23:10 background reclaim still present on a subset of nodes.

alice: Hypothesis A: sudden surge in cold starts + large working set -> pagefault storm -> kernel reclaim on GPU hosts -> big tail. Evidence: mm_vmscan samples, swap traffic, trace spans showing pagein waits.

alice: Hypothesis B: recent kernel/ops change removed a tuning that previously helped (e.g., zone reclaim or min_free_kbytes); regression in kernel config increases pagefault cost. Need to diff kernel boot params / packaging.

charlie: Host uname/build: "Linux gpu-host 5.10.102-redwood-gpu #1 SMP ... ginx-deploy-batch-2026-03-15" (matches recent infra roll).

dana: Correlation: Customer-X had a sudden spike in long-sequence generation at 22:38 which correlates with onset.

bob: Preparing for a handoff at 00:00Z. @ryan-sre will take lead; alice please prepare handoff notes.

ryan-sre: I'll take post-handshake. Please attach remaining traces + list of affected instances. Also want dmesg + kernel boot params.

alice: Pushing instance list: i-0a1b2c3d, i-0d4c5b6a, i-0a9b8c7d. Logs uploaded: https://logs.redwood/incident/5132467890/logs (permission: incident-team).

incbot: NOTE: Priority set to sev2. If latency regressions continue and customers degrade escalate to Eng-ML and Execs.

ryan-sre: Remediation plan: 1) revert kernel tuning change in next infra deploy 2) disable swap on GPU hosts for short term 3) schedule controlled reboots for nodes after replacement 4) engineer cache prewarm improvements to avoid cold page storms. Reboot risk: 1-2min disruption per node for Dedicated pools.

dana: I'll draft customer comms and offer credits where SLOs may be affected.

alice: dmesg snippets captured: 

```
[Mar16 22:39] MM: page allocation failure: order:0, mode:0x40
[Mar16 22:40] vmalloc: allocation failed, size=20480
[Mar16 22:41] NMI watchdog: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#2 stuck for 22s
```

charlie: Uploaded the kernel logs + perf samples to the drive bundle.

ryan-sre: Acknowledged handoff. I'll coordinate kernel revert with eng-infra and cache work with eng-ml. Leaving this thread as active for notes.

incbot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: p95 returned within SLO at 2026-03-17T01:05Z after routing and instance replacement. RCA owner: eng-infra + eng-ml. Action items: revert kernel tuning, disable swap on GPU hosts, improve cache prewarm, add more targeted tracing for pagefault-heavy spans.

dana: Closing action: customer follow-ups in progress. Filing incident summary doc: https://docs.redwood/incidents/5132467890-summary

alice: Leaving oncall but reachable by phone. Handoff complete.

ryan-sre: Thanks team — starting RCA doc population and linking artifacts.

End of thread."
